name: @gcu/dispatch
description: Session-trained natural-language → tool-call dispatch: a Snips-shaped resolver (averaged-perceptron intent + CRF-class slot tagger + gazetteers + deterministic per-kind assemblers) that trains IN THE BROWSER from the host session's own vocabulary in under a second. Tools are declarative (ten kinds); no shipped model, no network, explainable per decision — refusals return empty calls so the host degrades into its command palette. Born from an incubator where this beat a 26M finetuned transformer 50/52 to 3/24 on a frozen yardstick.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
